outcome: Suspected relapse during 6 months after birth
cohort: 218 women with multiple sclerosis (MS) under regular care at the Programa de Esclerosis Multiple UC in Chile
finding: Women with MS tend to have fewer children at an older age after diagnosis, and experience a threefold increase in cesarean section rates, but no differences in newborn outcomes were observed.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were three times higher in the PostMS group compared to the PreMS group.
birth_weight: Mentioned as weight/size at birth, but no specific values provided
